newsitem.title: USA: UNR Industries Q1 net off, sales climb.
newsitem.headline: UNR Industries Q1 net off, sales climb.

text.p: UNR Industries Inc said Monday net income in the first quarter ended March 31 fell short of net income a year ago, which included a gain from the sale of discontinued operations.

The company reported net income of $4.7 million, or $0.09 a share, compared to $4.9 million, or $0.10, in the same period last year. The 1996 figure included a $1.4 million, or $0.03, gain from the asset sale, UNR said.
Without the gain, UNR said it posted net income of $3.5 million, or $0.07 a share in the first quarter of 1996.
Sales in the period climbed to $37.7 million from $31.0 million a year ago, UNR said.
UNR makes and installs towers, shelters, cabinets and mounts for the telecommunications industry.
Its shares closed off 5/16 Monday at 6-1/8.
